import unittest
import asset_import as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_identifiers(self):
        self.assertEqual(app.clean_codes([' 00127 ', '000', ' ']), ['00127', '000'])
        self.assertEqual(app.clean_codes(['0', '00', '7', '7']), ['0', '00', '7', '7'])
        self.assertEqual(app.clean_codes(['\t015\n', '', '\t']), ['015'])
        self.assertEqual(app.clean_codes([]), [])
    def test_no_mutation(self):
        codes = [' 008 ', '']
        self.assertEqual(app.clean_codes(codes), ['008'])
        self.assertEqual(codes, [' 008 ', ''])

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
